title: Patient-Provider Dispute Eligibility on Riverbend Charges — Good Faith & Price Estimates
content:
**Coverage.** The federal patient-provider dispute process is available only to a Good Faith & Price Estimates estimate whose recorded coverage answer is one of the eligible coverage answers of its type. The coverage answer is the one recorded on the estimate.

**Window.** A dispute is eligible only when the patient initiated it no later than the dispute window counted from the date on the initial bill. The clock starts from the initial bill date recorded on the estimate; count calendar days starting the day after that date; a dispute initiated on the last day of the window (day 120 under the type's initiation window) is timely. The initiation date is the one stated on the dispute notice.

**Threshold.** The process is further available only when Riverbend's billed charges for the service exceed Riverbend's expected charges on the latest version furnished by at least the dispute threshold, compared per provider or facility. Riverbend's billed charges are the self-pay final bill less the uninsured discount; its expected charges are the sum of the Riverbend facility and Riverbend professional lines of that version. Co-providers' bills are disputed with those co-providers, not with Riverbend.

**Fee and hold.** The patient pays the administrative fee to the dispute resolution entity. While the dispute is pending, the linked hospital account is placed on a billing hold with the type's dispute hold reason and receives no escalating statements, final notice or collection action; the patient may still pay undisputed amounts.

## Boundary cases (abstract days; hypothetical amounts)

| Initiation date | Timely? |
|---|---|
| the day after the initial bill date (day 1) | yes |
| day 120 | yes |
| day 121 | no |

| Riverbend expected charges (facility plus professional lines) | Riverbend billed charges (self-pay final bill less uninsured discount) | Excess | Threshold met? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3000.00 | 3400.00 | 400.00 | yes |
| 3000.00 | 3399.99 | 399.99 | no |

An anesthesia co-provider line plays no part in the comparison with Riverbend's charges.
